s.note: the coins that pay for everything in his world
s.how: Grate 150g parmesan finely and mix with picked thyme leaves. Spoon into small rounds on a tray lined with baking paper, leaving space between. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden. Crack black pepper over each and cool on the tray to crisp. Serve with a small bowl of tomato chutney for dabbing.

s.note: drinks at the bar where no business gets done
s.how: Warm 300g green olives in 60ml olive oil with 3 strips orange peel, 2 sprigs rosemary and 2 sliced garlic cloves over low heat for 5 minutes. Toast 100g almonds with a pinch of salt. Serve both in small bowls, the hotel bar way.

m.n: Dinner for twelve braised short ribs
m.how: Season and brown 2kg beef short ribs in batches. Add 375ml red wine, 500ml stock, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours until tender. Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat. Cook 200g polenta in 1L water, stirring, for 10 minutes, then beat in 40g butter and 40g parmesan. Spoon the ribs over.

w.how: Beat 100g butter with 100g peanut butter and 80g icing sugar, then mix in 200g flour. Roll out, cut into small bone shapes and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool and half dip in 100g melted dark chocolate. Human food only.

d.note: Addy behind the bar, the usual
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Dot 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam.
